# Test fixtures

- `positron-style-sample.json` — verbatim copy of the OpenFreeMap Positron style
  (`https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/positron`), as cached by the app under
  `output/.maps/tile-cache/styles/positron.json` on 2026-09-13. Derived from OpenMapTiles
  Positron (code BSD-3-Clause, design CC-BY 4.0). No API keys.
- `dark-style-sample.json` — trimmed sample of the dark style for the transform tests.
